invalid_json.description: Provider JSON body syntax error or failure to decode JSON object.

schema_mismatch.description: Parsed JSON fails prediction.schema.json property/type constraints.

truncation.description: Output truncated before completion, missing structural closing braces.

refusal.description: Model safety or policy refusal response.

empty_response.description: Provider response content is zero-length or empty string.

provider_error.description: HTTP 5xx server or gateway failure from provider.

wrong_model.description: Provider reported model ID does not match requested model ID.

timeout.description: Request timed out waiting for provider response headers/body.

content_format_violation.description: Response wrapped in disallowed markdown/text fences or non-JSON wrapper.

semantic_failure.description: Valid JSON schema output containing logically impossible or invalid domain states.

rate_limit_exhaustion.description: HTTP 429 Too Many Requests or quota depletion.

unclassified_error.description: Unclassified exception or unexpected failure mode.
